requirement.description: The View.__getattr__ method has incorrect error handling for missing fields and reserved names. Currently it raises generic AttributeErrors instead of specific error messages that match test expectations, and doesn't properly handle reserved attribute names that exist in the layout.
requirement.contract: When accessing a non-existent field via attribute access, the method should raise an AttributeError with a specific message format including similar field names. When accessing a reserved name (starting with underscore) that exists in the layout, it should raise an AttributeError indicating the field must be accessed via indexing.

requirement.description: The Layout._convert_to_int method incorrectly handles dictionary-based reset values for Union layouts. It doesn't properly validate that only one field can be provided for Union layouts, causing TypeError instead of ValueError.
requirement.contract: When converting a dictionary-based reset value for a UnionLayout, it should validate that at most one field is specified and raise a ValueError with specific message format if more than one field is provided.

requirement.description: The View.__getitem__ method does not properly handle dynamic indexing for array layouts. It raises TypeError instead of the expected error message when trying to index a struct layout with a value.
requirement.contract: When attempting to index a struct layout (not array layout) with a Value, it should raise a TypeError with specific message format indicating only array layouts can be indexed with values.

requirement.description: The _AggregateMeta class does not properly validate reset values for Union classes. It doesn't enforce the constraint that only one field can have a reset value in Union classes.
requirement.contract: When creating a Union class with multiple reset values, it should raise a ValueError with specific message format indicating only one field can be reset.

requirement.description: The Field class does not properly handle shape casting in certain scenarios, particularly when used with custom ShapeCastable objects.
requirement.contract: Field construction should properly validate shape-castable objects and maintain correct shape properties for all supported shape types.
